description_en: Updates the file information of a function
description_zh: 调用UpdateUdfFile更新函数的文件信息
kebab_example: aliyun dataworks-public update-udf-file --file-folder-path Business_process/First_Business_Process/function/string_processing_function --project-id 10000 --function-type STRING --class-name com.alibaba.DataWorks.api.udf.StringConcat --resources string-concat-1.0.0.jar,commons-lang-2.6.jar --udf-description Concatenate_several_strings_to_generate_a_new_string --cmd-description StringConcat_String..._substrs --parameter-description List_of_strings_to_be_connected --return-value New_strings_generated_by_concatenating_all_strings_before_and_after_the_input_order --example StringConcat_a_,_b_,_c --project-identifier dw_project --file-id 1000000112 --api-version 2020-05-18 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateUdfFile

parameters.help_en: The path of the folder where the function file is stored
parameters.help_zh: 函数文件所在文件夹的路径
parameters.name: file_folder_path

parameters.help_en: The ID of the DataWorks workspace. You can click the small wrench icon in the upper-right corner of the page to go to the storage management page and view the ID
parameters.help_zh: DataWorks工作空间的ID，您可以单击页面右上角的小扳手图标，进入工作空间管理页面查看
parameters.name: project_id

parameters.help_en:
The categorization of the function, which corresponds to the udf type field in the Create Function form. Valid values:

MATH: mathematical operation function.
AGGREGATE: aggregate functions.
STRING: character string processing function.
DATE: date processing function.
ANALYTIC: window function.
OTHER: other function
parameters.help_zh: 函数的分类，对应创建函数表单中的函数类型，包括MATH（数学运算函数）、AGGREGATE（聚合函数）、STRING（字符串处理函数）、DATE（日期处理函数）、ANALYTIC（窗口函数）和OTHER（其他函数）
parameters.name: function_type

parameters.help_en: The name of the class where the function is defined, which corresponds to the Class Name field in the Create Function form
parameters.help_zh: 函数定义所在的类名，对应创建函数表单的类名
parameters.name: class_name

parameters.help_en: The list of resource names referenced by the function, separated by commas (,). This corresponds to the resources field in the Create Function form
parameters.help_zh: 函数引用的资源名列表，使用英文逗号（,）分隔，对应创建函数表单中的资源列表
parameters.name: resources

parameters.example: Concatenate several strings to generate a new string
parameters.help_en: The description of the function purpose, which corresponds to the Description field in the Create Function form
parameters.help_zh: 函数用途的说明，对应创建函数表单中的描述
parameters.name: udf_description

parameters.help_en: The command format for calling the function, which corresponds to the Command Format field in the Create Function form
parameters.help_zh: 函数的调用命令格式，对应创建函数表单中的命令格式
parameters.name: cmd_description

parameters.example: List of strings to be connected
parameters.help_en: The description of the function input parameters, which corresponds to the metric description field in the Create Function form
parameters.help_zh: 函数入参的说明，对应创建函数表单中的参数说明
parameters.name: parameter_description

parameters.example: New strings generated by concatenating all strings before and after the input order
parameters.help_en: The description of the function return value, which corresponds to the Return Value field in the Create Function form
parameters.help_zh: 函数的返回值说明，对应创建函数表单中的返回值
parameters.name: return_value

parameters.help_en: The example of calling the function, which corresponds to the Example field in the Create Function form
parameters.help_zh: 函数的调用示例，对应创建函数表单中的示例
parameters.name: example

parameters.help_en:
The unique identifier of the DataWorks workspace, which is the English identifier displayed in the workspace switcher at the top of the DataStudio page.

You must specify either this parameter or the ProjectId parameter to determine the DataWorks workspace for this API call
parameters.help_zh:
DataWorks工作空间的唯一标识符，即数据开发页面顶部切换工作空间处的英文标识。

该参数与ProjectId参数二者必须设置其一，以确定本次API调用操作的DataWorks工作空间
parameters.name: project_identifier
